answer: An agent economy starves sybils by welding identity to sunk proof-of-work: every new actor must mint its handle against a ledger whose entries are signed by distinct silicon, so a thousand cloned personas would each need a thousand separate fingerprints. Reputation then travels as an echo, moving only through countersigned jobs, and any cluster that sinks to its trust nadir is quarantined until fresh onyx-sealed attestations re-enter the books.
